notes: Developer catalog lists Job Posting, Apply Connect, Apply with LinkedIn and Recruiter System Connect. The catalog page does not state approval requirements. Job Posting API has its own terms of use. Footer language list shows English (English) as the selected option; no other languages seen on pages read. Developer site has app creation and an Apply now step for one API; access rules not stated on pages read. Only two public pages read (homepage and developer site) to limit automated access. The language switcher lists 36 entries; the two Chinese variants are mapped to zh, giving 35 codes. Footer shows LinkedIn © 2026 and an About link; parent not stated on the page. developer.linkedin.com lists APIs with Create app and Apply now buttons, but does not say whether a key is required.
